commands.name: SkLevel
commands.label: Level
commands.description: Level: add a datum level - pick its elevation in an elevation view or type it

commands.name: SkLevels
commands.label: Levels
commands.description: Levels: rename levels, change elevations, add a level above, go to a level

commands.name: SkGrid
commands.label: Grid
commands.description: Grid: draw grid lines named 1, 2, 3 or A, B, C with a bubble at the end; type a new name into a bubble and the grids after it follow; drag a bubble along its grid to lengthen it; in a datum box the ends sit on the box

commands.name: SkRenumberGrids
commands.label: Renumber Grids
commands.description: Renumber Grids: name grids one after another (1, 2, 3 or A, B, C) - pick them in order, or select several and draw a direction across them

commands.name: SkGridBubbles
commands.label: Grid Bubbles
commands.description: Grid Bubbles: tick Top, Bottom, Left or Right around a diagram of the grids - bubbles on those sides of the active view; in a layout detail only that detail changes

commands.name: SkDatumBox
commands.label: Datum Box
commands.description: Datum Box: one box holds the extents of the levels and the ends of the grids in it - move, scale or rotate the box and they follow; drag a level's head sideways, or a grid's bubble along it, to take that one out

commands.name: SkGoToLevel
commands.label: Go To Level
commands.description: Go To Level: set the CPlane to a level, with a plan view and a view range (plan cut)

commands.name: SkAttachToLevel
commands.label: Attach to Level
commands.description: Attach to Level: objects move with the level when its elevation changes

commands.name: SkDetachFromLevel
commands.label: Detach
commands.description: Detach from Level: objects no longer follow their level

commands.name: SkSpotElevation
commands.label: Spot Elevation
commands.description: Spot Elevation: elevation of a point on a surface, polysurface, mesh, SubD, edge or curve - follows its host

commands.name: SkSpotCoordinate
commands.label: Spot Coordinate
commands.description: Spot Coordinate: north / east coordinates of a point from the project base point, survey point, internal origin or a named CPlane

commands.name: SkSpotSlope
commands.label: Spot Slope
commands.description: Spot Slope: slope arrow on a surface, terrain mesh or edge; drag its end grips to set its reach, move it and it measures where it is - percent, rise / 12", 1:x, degrees ...

commands.name: SkNorthArrow
commands.label: North Arrow
commands.description: North Arrow: a north arrow that always points to true north (or project north)

commands.name: SkEditType
commands.label: Type Properties
commands.description: Type Properties: edit the type of the selected Skunk element (Edit Type)

commands.name: SkProperties
commands.label: Attributes
commands.description: Skunk Attributes: the dockable panel with the type and parameters of the selected Skunk elements - opens it, or closes it when its tab is in front

commands.name: SkLocation
commands.label: Location
commands.description: Location: the project location (the Rhino model's geographic location and Rhino's north), project base point, survey point, angle to true north and their named CPlanes

right.tooltip: Print the location on the command line

commands.name: SkProjectBasePoint
commands.label: Project Base Point
commands.description: Project Base Point: move it (the model stays) or type its shared coordinates and angle to true north

commands.name: SkSurveyPoint
commands.label: Survey Point
commands.description: Survey Point: move it clipped (the shared system moves) or unclipped, or type its values

commands.name: SkSpecifyCoordinates
commands.label: Specify Coordinates
commands.description: Specify Coordinates at Point: give a picked point its shared coordinates and true north

commands.name: SkReportCoordinates
commands.label: Report Coordinates
commands.description: Report Shared Coordinates: shared, project and internal coordinates of picked points

commands.name: SkImportSharedCoordinates
commands.label: Import Shared Coordinates
commands.description: Import Shared Coordinates: match a BIM model's shared coordinates - run the Python snippet in its console, paste the result back

commands.name: SkRotateTrueNorth
commands.label: Rotate True North
commands.description: Rotate True North: turn the shared coordinate system about the project base point or survey point - the model stays

commands.name: SkRotateProjectNorth
commands.label: Rotate Project North
commands.description: Rotate Project North: rotate the model (90 degrees, 180, an angle, or align to a line); shared coordinates stay

commands.name: SkUpdate
commands.label: Update
commands.description: Update: re-sync every level, spot and north arrow with its host and the coordinate systems

commands.name: SkSettings
commands.label: Settings
commands.description: Settings: annotation scale (view scale), plan cut, keyboard aliases, start with Rhino

commands.name: Skunk
commands.label: Skunk
commands.description: Skunk: load Skunk, start live updates and load the Skunk toolbar (add Skunk to Rhino's startup commands)

commands.name: SkAbout
commands.label: About
commands.description: About Skunk: version, what it does, where it is installed

commands.name: SkOrientView
commands.label: Orientation
commands.description: Orientation: turn the plan view so true north points up

right.tooltip: Turn the plan view so project north points up

commands.name: SkShowSite
commands.label: Site Points
commands.description: Show / hide the internal origin, project base point and survey point
